title: Home Protection Plans Sales Eligibility Matrix
content:
Where each Home Protection Plan may be sold, to which premises, through which channels, how it may be billed, and how many of it a premise may hold.

## Premise, state and service requirements

| Plan | Premise class served | States in which the plan is sold | Premise must have gas utility service | Excludes holding any other protection plan at the same premise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Surge Shield | Residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge Electric Line Guard | Residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard | Residential | PA, OH, IL, MD | Yes | No |
| Beacon Ridge Home Wiring Care | Residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Repair Plan | Residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge HVAC Complete | Residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | No | No |
| Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield | Residential | PA, OH, IL, NJ, MD | No | Yes |

## Billing, channel and holding terms (identical for all seven plans)

| Term | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Billing methods available | On the Beacon Ridge energy bill; by direct invoice |
| Billing on the energy bill requires an active Beacon Ridge electricity or gas agreement at the premise | Yes |
| Direct invoicing requires automatic payment | Yes |
| Channels through which the plan may be sold | Phone; web |
| Live plans of the same plan allowed per premise | 1 |

## Reading the matrix

- **New Jersey.** Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard is the one plan not sold in NJ; the other six are sold in all five states.
- **Gas service.** Only Beacon Ridge Gas Line Guard requires the premise to have gas utility service.
- **Exclusive plan.** Only Beacon Ridge Whole Home Shield excludes holding any other protection plan at the same premise.
- **Commercial premises.** Every plan serves residential premises only; no plan in the line lists a commercial premise class.
